result.summary: The page is generally polished, but horizontal carousel content is visibly clipped and the fixed bottom navigation obscures the next restaurant card.

issues.description: The category chip row extends beyond the viewport: the next chip is partially visible at the right edge, making the row look cut off.
issues.suggestion: Keep the carousel intentionally scrollable with a clear peek affordance, or constrain and size the chips so the row does not appear accidentally clipped.

issues.description: The fastest-near-you restaurant carousel clips the third card and truncates its restaurant name at the right edge.
issues.suggestion: Use a deliberate carousel layout with consistent card widths and scrolling indicators, or fit the cards within the viewport and ensure text truncation is intentional.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlays the second popular restaurant card, cutting off its image and hiding the card's title and details.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content or adjust the navigation overlay so the final card can be fully viewed above it.
